**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of the problem, e.g. "I'm always frustrated when […]".

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What should happen, concretely.

**Scope check — please read before submitting**

The contract's economics are deliberately frozen: deposit-to-mint,
burn-to-redeem, one-time composition, **no price feed, no swaps, no fees**.
Features that would change this (adding an oracle, trading, yield strategies,
mainnet deployment) will be declined unless they arrive with a genuinely new
safety argument — open a discussion-first issue for those instead of a PR.

Good fits: frontend UX, health/diagnostics tooling, docs, CI, test coverage.

**Alternatives you considered**
Other approaches or workarounds.

**Additional context**
Links, references, mockups.
